points.name: kamidori.experience.after_calculation
points.description: The award is final and not yet applied. L[0x1] holds the experience the character receives: G[0xfec0c], the amount the caller passes (COMMITBTL after a battle, FIELD), times the costume bonus (100, plus 25 for each of the four item_costume_gem_sockets of character_costume_item_id[current_character_id] that holds 0x118), over 100. current_unit_id is the unit and current_character_id its canonical character, whose character_levels, character_experience and unit_level_cap the award reads. Every path reaches this instruction, so `before site` sees every award and may rewrite L[0x1]; an amount of 0 or less, or a character at its level cap, gains no experience. Weapon experience (G[0xfec0d] and the equipped item) is decided after this point and does not read L[0x1].

points.name: kamidori.boot.data_layered
points.description: The instruction after op 0x143 (INIT2@0x20c). Every layer has written its data: the 28 base *INIT scripts, then each mounted append's $n$AUTORUN and its $n$*INIT layers. The boot has not used the tables yet. INIT2 goes on to fill each unset text colour setting from voice_setting_default_text_colors, to rebuild the field when a save made on a floor is loaded (G[0x428c]: the stage loaders, then SETMAPTEX, whose READICON reads unit_graphic_asset_ids and item_costume_graphic_asset_ids), and to set up the studio's ornaments. None of it writes a record table, so that work reads an edit made here. The tables lie above the saved prefix (0xfd40f): a load zeroes them, the prologue builds them again, and control reaches here again while the load restores.

points.name: kamidori.boot.data_ready
points.description: INIT2's exit. Every data table is built: the 28 base *INIT scripts, each mounted append's $n$AUTORUN and its $n$*INIT layers (op 0x143), and INIT2's own work after them, which reads the tables (kamidori.boot.data_layered). An edit made here comes after that work. The tables lie above the saved prefix (0xfd40f): a load zeroes them, the prologue builds them again, and control reaches here again while the load restores.

points.name: kamidori.stage.after_info_reload
points.description: INFO's third tab (INFO3, which FIELD opens from its menu) has run every stage's loaders for its list of enemies (INFO3@0xb88 to 0xc12), and then, on a floor (G[0x428c] set), put current_stage_id back and run that stage's loaders again (INFO3@0xcdc to 0xd1a): the floor's enemy slots, objects and rules hold the stage as authored, and the units on the field are where they were.
